material.description: docs/MODDING.md says waves_example, killer, custom_unit, upgrade_tree_example, unit_queries, custom_item and custom_spell use game.var, game.player_var, game.unit_var, game.region, game.region_center, game.score and game.add_score, which do not load. Bind those names or port the mods to bound names. Witness: each example mod loads on the piccolo host in the mod-host test that loads every example.
material.subject: Seven example mods use Lua names the piccolo host does not bind
material.witness: mod_check on the moba scenario, 30 ticks: custom_spell, custom_unit, killer, custom_item, waves_example, unit_queries all load and run (mod-state lines); upgrade_tree_example loads and runs with its mods/upgrades.lua dependency, as its header requires. Standalone load fails only for the missing dependency.
